name: SK Networks Company Limited
summary: SK Networks Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the import, export, and sale of information and communication devices in South Korea, China, and internationally. It operates through Trading, Information and Communication, Speed Mate, SK Magic, and Others segments.
